about.title: ABOUT US
content: Founded in 2020, MPL & MC Engenharia, Lda. operates within the construction sector, specializing in the rehabilitation and construction of both residential and commercial buildings.

We are committed to the execution, management, supervision, and monitoring of our projects, relying on the technical expertise and experience of our professionals, who form a young, dynamic, and responsible team.

Our engineering and construction solutions are carefully tailored to meet the unique needs of each client, with detailed budget proposals aimed at optimizing costs while ensuring the timely completion of projects.

Our primary focus is on delivering exceptional quality, which enables us to diferentiate ourselves in this highly competitive market. Our reputation has been built on providing personalized service to our clients.

Additional: Tender phase documentation, specifications and quantity surveys

content.title: São Domingos de Rana, 2022
content.description: Renovation of a single-family home, defined by the opening of spaces, soft architectural lines, and a strong connection to the surrounding outdoors.

content.title: Parede, 2025 (ongoing)
content.description: Demolition and reconstruction of a residential building in the historic center of Parede, designed for multi-family housing.

content.title: São João do Estoril, 2025 (ongoing)
content.description: Reconstruction of a 19th-century chalet, preserving its original character while transforming the interior into a modern and welcoming space — with the historic millstone that once stood here carefully integrated.

content.title: Parede, 2024
content.description: Complete renovation of a detached house in the center of Parede, involving major works in the basement and bathrooms, the use of carpentry to harmonize the interior spaces, as well as a full refurbishment of the outdoor area (fences, flooring, cladding, and waterproofing), and the conversion of an outbuilding to provide guests with a welcoming and comfortable space.

content.title: Manique, 2022
content.description: Guided by extensive use of bespoke carpentry, we rehabilitated this 19th-century house to create a new residential unit complemented by an adjoining commercial area.

content.title: Carcavelos, 2023
content.description: Following the completion of public sewage connections, we revitalized two distinct areas within a villa in the heart of Carcavelos.

content.title: Avenidas Novas, 2024
content.description: Apartment on Av. João Crisóstomo, Lisbon, reimagined for long-term rental. The project focused on optimizing space and achieving a significant improvement in energy performance, in line with the city’s rehabilitation guidelines.

content.title: Parede, 2023
content.description: Interior fit-out for one of Cascais’ most renowned restaurants, enhancing natural light and creating a seamless flow between dining room and kitchen in the daily rhythm of O Toscano.

content.title: Parede, 2023–2024
content.description: Comprehensive refurbishment of an exterior patio, swimming pool, landscaping, roofing, painting, and waterproofing works for a villa with breathtaking views over Parede.

content.title: Parede, 2023
content.description: Complete renovation of a spacious four-bedroom apartment in central Parede, prioritizing simplicity and clean architectural lines.

content.title: Carcavelos, 2024
content.description: In the heart of Carcavelos, we gave new life to an early-2000s four-bedroom apartment.

content.title: Carcavelos, 2023
content.description: Transformation of a mid-20th-century space into a modern and inviting short-term rental, just steps from Carcavelos beach.

content.title: Junqueiro, 2023
content.description: Full rehabilitation of a small apartment converted into short-term rental accommodation in a prime coastal location.

content.title: Parede, 2022
content.description: Exterior renovation of a single-family home in a gated community, crowned by the integration of a modern pergola.

content.title: Campo de Ourique, 2023
content.description: Complete rehabilitation of a compact short-term rental apartment in one of Lisbon’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

content.title: Parede, 2021
content.description: Transformation of the outdoor area of a single-family home in Parede, including the creation of a cozy winter garden, new finishes, and proper waterproofing of the flat roof.

content.title: Structural Reinforcement Projects
content.description: Many architectural interventions require structural reinforcement prior to execution — a crucial foundation for long-term stability and design integrity.
